title: Focus Study Sprint
user: A student or self-learner who wants short, calm, active-recall sessions without streaks, rewards, feeds, or an AI content firehose.
smallest_useful_product: A PWA where users paste 5–30 prompts, choose 5/10/20 minutes, answer in a distraction-free loop, and receive a private session recap with no streak or leaderboard.
constraints: No behavioral analytics by default; keyboard-first, reduced-motion, screen-reader labels; no learning claims beyond practice support.
